verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents automations and workflows that run on a schedule or in response to webhook events, integrating with Slack, GitHub, Linear and more [gh-4]. It describes concrete background automation templates: incident triage, PR review on a label, CI failure fix PRs, security remediation and Slack mention monitoring [docs-7..11, docs-37], plus Agent Canvas as a control center for automations [docs-36]. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party setup/configuration docs for scheduled automations (the evidence is mostly marketing-level descriptions), and independent or hands-on corroboration that they run reliably unattended.
